# Max Pergola

> Max Pergola is a factory-direct brand for aluminum louvered pergola kits serving residential projects in the United States. The site uses US customary dimensions as the primary units and provides metric references.

Current fulfillment: factory-direct DDP delivery from Chongqing to a quoted US destination. Max Pergola plans to begin Los Angeles warehouse fulfillment for qualifying in-stock standard SKUs in July 2027. Prices, engineering criteria, availability and delivery are confirmed by written project quote rather than assumed from the website.

## Products

- [Aluminum pergola kits](https://maxpergola.com/pergola-kits/): Configure 10 × 10 ft, 12 × 16 ft and 12 × 20 ft nominal footprints, compare metric dimensions, select preparation options and create a quote-ready SKU.

## Planning guides

- [DIY pergola guide](https://maxpergola.com/diy-pergola/): Site, foundation, inventory, frame, roof and final-check planning sequence for an aluminum pergola kit.
- [Backyard pergola ideas](https://maxpergola.com/backyard-pergola-ideas/): Six practical residential layouts for dining, poolside kitchens, compact patios and evening lounges.
- [Pergola vs gazebo](https://maxpergola.com/pergola-vs-gazebo/): Neutral comparison of roof design, shade, rain response, appearance and use.
